title.en: A heartbeat log you can check
title.zh-CN: 一份可核验的心跳记录

subtitle.en: The same script writes heartbeats.jsonl until the deadline.
subtitle.zh-CN: 同一脚本持续写入 heartbeats.jsonl，直到截止时间。

prompt.en: Use bot-keepalive to keep the guard running for 1 hour, leave a heartbeat log, stop at the deadline, and report what you measured. Do not auto-repeat, and do not touch my network or other work.
prompt.zh-CN: 用 bot-keepalive 保活一小时。请每分钟写下心跳记录，到我设定的截止时间就停止，不要自动续跑，最后报告你实际测到的结果。不要改动网络或其他工作，这份心跳记录要可以核对。
